ctbids-47939-5585482.description:
Antique Frank M. Whiting & Company hand-chased Sterling silver pitcher from the same ornate #640 design family. This elegant footed pitcher features a tall reeded body richly hand chased with flowers, scrolling foliage and finely textured backgrounds surrounding a central cartouche. The dramatic flared pouring lip, sculptural scroll handle with foliate detailing, gadrooned borders and raised pedestal foot give the piece an especially impressive profile. Its decoration closely coordinates with the other #640 serving pieces while the open pitcher form makes it a striking display piece on its own.
Clearly marked “HAND CHASED / STERLING / BY FRANK M. WHITING & COMPANY” with the Whiting trademark and 640. Approximately 281 g. The 640 designation identifies the Whiting design/service rather than a manufacture date. Very good condition with surface wear and scratching consistent with age and use. No dents or dings. See photos for dimensions and additional condition details.

277045675.description: This lot includes four assorted raw mineral gemstone specimens in natural, unpolished condition. It contains two pieces of black tourmaline with striated, columnar structures and dark metallic luster. There is one greenish fibrous mineral specimen, likely actinolite or a similar mineral. Also included is a large rough matrix rock with silvery metallic flecks, possibly containing pyrite or mica, showing gold and grey mineralization. All specimens exhibit typical surface texture, minor chips, and some adhering matrix material. Sizes range from small hand specimens to larger chunks. No branding or manufacturer information is present. These pieces are suitable for collectors, educational use, or metaphysical purposes.

This lot features a variety of polished and raw semi-precious gemstone specimens. Included are agate slices with gold-toned edges in shades of gray, brown, and green, some showing banding and crystalline structures. - Colorful tumbled stones in purple, blue, green, pink, and clear
